expected.vintageNote: These are the 20260816 export's measured values and must be re-measured on every refresh, not carried forward. The window ROLLS rather than extends - the 20260807/09 vintage was 1,255 days over 2021-08-09..2026-08-07, so both ends moved. The 20260816 files were exported on Sunday 2026-08-16 but carry a Monday 2026-08-17 calendar row holding Friday's forward-filled price and volume; the >95% price-AND-volume repeated-row rule catches it (holidays 50 -> 51), which is why the last trading day is 2026-08-14 and not 2026-08-17. If a future refresh ever shows lastDate equal to the export's own weekend/Monday stamp, that placeholder survived and the build is wrong.

calendar.note: Holiday detection compares each weekday row against the prior SURVIVING row and requires >95% of the universe to repeat on price AND volume. Exact whole-row equality is NOT sufficient - it under-detects badly (software returns 11 holidays instead of 50). Weekend drop must run first.

breadth.note: Prior art drifted 30 (build_dashboard.py:422) -> 25 (build_renmac_dashboard.py:238) undocumented. Config value now; changing it changes both.

weights.note: Sums to 100. THERE IS NO PILLAR D - earnings-cycle inflection is deliberately unscorable because price leads EPS revisions by ~2 quarters, so scoring it double-counts pillar B. Do not 'close' this gap. Missing pillars are DROPPED and remaining weights RENORMALISED, never zeroed.

regime.ladderNote: Evaluated IN ORDER, FIRST MATCH WINS. Score bands alone are insufficient - each rung carries a structural gate. Late-cycle topping is checked LAST because it can fire at a high composite score; a pure band lookup called April 2026 'momentum expansion'.

ladder.note: top_confirmed = anchor=='peak' AND crack_i AND (retest_i OR ma_break_i). Identical measurements, OPPOSITE instruction. The washout is buyable; inside a confirmed top the oversold bounces fail and the base case is 18-24 months of malaise.

peak.title: {universeLabel} composite peak
peak.detail: Composite high of {value} on {date}; {offPeak}% below it today.

trough.title: {universeLabel} composite trough
trough.detail: Composite low of {value} on {date}; {upFromTrough}% above it today.

crack.title: First crack in the trend
crack.detail: {pct}% over five sessions into {date} - the first {threshold}% five-day break of the window.

thrust.title: Thrust off the low
thrust.detail: +{pct}% over five sessions into {date}, with {b20}% of names above their 20-dma.

retest.title: Failed retest
retest.detail: Rallied {pct}% off the {lowDate} low and stalled {offPeak}% below the high.

held.title: Retest held
held.detail: Pulled back to {pct}% above the {lowDate} low without undercutting it.

ma_break.title: {ma}-dma break
ma_break.detail: Composite closed below its {ma}-dma on {date} for the first time in {sinceDays} sessions.

climax.title: Selling climax
climax.detail: {pct}% in five sessions into {date}; {b20}% of the universe above its 20-dma.

washout.title: Breadth washout
washout.detail: Only {b20}% above the 20-dma and {b50}% above the 50-dma on {date}.

bubble.title: Bubble signal
bubble.detail: {count} of {total} names doubled inside two years as of {date} - the framework's extension flag, not a sell signal on its own.

whipsaw.title: Whipsaw zone
whipsaw.detail: {crosses} 20/50-dma crosses in {window} sessions - the trend system is whipsawing and its signal is neutralised.

interpretation.note: Prose is generated ONLY from these templates, formatted with facts the engine measured. There is deliberately no template for an external sourced claim (e.g. an earnings result or a fund-flow statistic), so one cannot be emitted. This replaces ~170 lines of hardcoded semiconductor prose in build_dashboard.py:534-702.

Capitulation / washout.confirm: a held retest, breadth back above 30%, and 3-month lows contracting
Capitulation / washout.invalidate: a lower low on expanding new lows

Capitulation inside a confirmed top.confirm: only a held retest PLUS breadth above 30% makes this a buyable base
Capitulation inside a confirmed top.invalidate: a thrust that holds its retest with 65-day highs expanding
Capitulation inside a confirmed top.note: Identical measurements to the washout case, opposite instruction. In a confirmed topping structure the oversold bounces fail; the base case is 18-24 months of malaise, not a V-shaped recovery.

Breakdown.confirm: nothing yet - wait for a climax and a held retest
Breakdown.invalidate: a thrust off a trough that holds

Bottoming / base.confirm: reclaim of a rising 50-dma; 65-day highs expanding
Bottoming / base.invalidate: an undercut of the trough; breadth back under 20%

Early recovery.invalidate: breadth back under 35%; a close below the 50-dma

Confirmed uptrend.invalidate: a first crack; two active negative divergences

Momentum expansion.confirm: extension mid-range reads 'not exhaustive' - stay long
Momentum expansion.invalidate: the extension percentile peaking and contracting; breadth diverging

Late-cycle topping.confirm: a failed retest and a 50-dma break confirm the top
Late-cycle topping.invalidate: a breadth thrust above 80% with new highs expanding

Indeterminate.confirm: no regime signal - do not force a trade

Bottoming / base.tilt: equipment first, memory second; leave analog for later

Early recovery.tilt: equipment then memory then analog as it broadens

Momentum expansion.tilt: AI/compute carrying alone is narrowing, not strength

Capitulation / washout.tilt: infrastructure and security first; exclude the crypto sleeve from the read entirely

Bottoming / base.tilt: infrastructure and security lead; application/SaaS confirms later

Early recovery.tilt: security then data/infra then application as it broadens

Momentum expansion.tilt: check whether the composite is the crypto sleeve - read the ex-crypto series before concluding anything

Capitulation / washout.tilt: AI server/ODM first; enterprise and storage confirm late

Bottoming / base.tilt: AI server and networking lead; storage and client confirm later

Early recovery.tilt: AI server then networking then storage and client

Momentum expansion.tilt: AI networking carrying alone is narrowing, not strength

Capitulation / washout.tilt: cyclicals and small caps lead off a washout; defensives leading a rally is not a recovery

Bottoming / base.tilt: cyclicals first; watch equal-weight vs cap-weight for confirmation

Early recovery.tilt: broadening into cyclicals and small caps is what makes it durable

Momentum expansion.tilt: check the equal-weight vs cap-weight spread - mega-cap-only expansion is narrowing

regimePlaybook._tiltNote: Only 'tilt' is universe-specific. Exposure, confirm and invalidate are framework-level and shared. The large-over-small tilt runs through every regime and is the most persistent single recommendation in the source set.

semis.note: Based on renmac_score.py:38-53, with corrections verified against the 2026-08-07 workbook. Memory and Thematic have their own drivers and are reported, never scored - a two-name basket is not a basket (Memory posted +42.8% on essentially one stock and would have been named 'leadership'). Added from the workbook's unassigned residual: PENG (Penguin Solutions, AI infra) -> AI/compute, MRAM (Everspin) -> Memory, PDFS (PDF Solutions, yield/EDA) -> WFE/equipment, AMBQ (Ambiq Micro, low-power MCU) -> Analog/MCU. CBRS and TE are left in Other/unclassified rather than guessed - reported, never scored. RTEC and MBLY are retained from the legacy list but are ABSENT from this workbook vintage; the loader reports unresolved members rather than dropping them silently.

software.note: Verified disjoint and complete against the 2026-08-09 workbook: 120 tickers, 6 baskets, zero duplicates, zero unassigned. Application/SaaS is the residual bucket. The crypto sleeve is reported, never scored, and excluded from the default composite - see universes.json splits. BMNR (Bitmine Immersion, an ETH-treasury name) is included in the crypto sleeve; membership is config-editable if that call is disputed.

hw_networking.note: Config is complete and correct. Unused until a clean workbook lands - the 2026-08-09 vintage carries semiconductor data under these headers.

_marketInternalsNote: market_internals has no static sub-baskets. Its baskets are the 11 GICS sectors and 25 industry groups from sectors.json, so pillar E runs over the rollup groups. vocabulary.market supplies the same lead/confirm/narrowing semantics.
